text_block_list.text: (WAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wheeeeeew!!
Miracle, you're soooo fast!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
That's incredible, getting a result like this in a graded race is seriously...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...
choice_data_list: Miracle! Welcome back. That was a great run!
Miracle! Welcome back. You ran so well!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Was that... a run that
you could consider 'good'?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Well then, that's a relief—

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! K.S.Miracle!
Could I speak with you for a moment...?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ! Um... You mean me?

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm so sorry to bother you when you're tired...!
Do you have just a moment to spare?!

...To be honest, I'd like to let her rest
immediately. But glancing over
at K.S.Miracle for a moment—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... Can I do the interview?
Since they went out of their way to ask me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Now then...!
KS Miracle-san, that was a truly
wonderful run just now.

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
I was especially astonished by your speed!
Do you consider that to be your greatest strength as well?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My speed... these legs,
they are my strength, and my pride.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's a miracle given to me by everyone...
who supported me, helped me stand back up,
and let me run.

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
I see... You believe you are who you are today thanks to the many miracles granted by your benefactors.
To feel such profound gratitude...

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone
is a truly wonderful person!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes... Yes, that's right!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Mom, Dad, my teacher... and Trainer, too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Every single one of them is a wonderful person...!

"More than when her results are recognized.
More than when her speed is praised.
It is when her benefactors are commended that she truly smiles."

Once again, I was reminded that the true essence
of KS Miracle's dream was 'giving back.'

And so, after finishing up the interview,
the moment we returned to the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... is it okay if we talk
about our next target race?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I want the next one to be as soon as possible.
I just want to run a lot."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I've thought it over. Since I'm on the sprint route—
I want to enter the Summer Sprint.

The Summer Sprint is...
one of the series held annually
around June through September as part of the "Summer Series."

It consists of six graded races between 1000m and 1200m,
and by competing in several of them,
they determine who is the fastest of the summer.

It certainly suits her aptitudes.
However, entering it would make the rotation intervals rather tight, and in the first place—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
First is your debut race. The Hakodate Sprint Stakes in June...
What do you think?

"Entering a race, from preparation to the main event,
is inherently a process that places
a tremendous burden on an Umamusume."

That's why, to be completely honest,
I'd prefer to give her a little more rest. However—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please.
...I really felt it today. It felt right.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Little by little, but still...
I'm finally doing... what I've always wanted to.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It made me feel...
like even I could do it."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
More... even more!
I want to run and leave behind real results...!

"...A blissful smile flashes across my mind.
Once upon a time, surely I had wished for it."
I want to keep her smiling with a face like this.

After letting out a short, quiet breath—
I nod in response to KS Miracle.
choice_data_list: Got it. Next up is the Hakodate Sprint Stakes.
Got it. Next up is the Hakodate Sprint Stakes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
Yes, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my absolute best to make sure I win.
I'm aiming for... first place."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be fine, really.
